quick_skim.title: Zero-Shot Face-to-Speech Synthesis via Latent Space Adaptation of a Style-Diffusion TTS Model
quick_skim.abstract: Zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) clones a voice from a short audio prompt, but this reliance on reference audio is a barrier when only visual information is available, e.g. for historical figures or video-game characters. In this work, we propose a Face-to-Speech (F2S) framework that predicts a plausible voice from a static facial image. A lightweight Face Adapter, together with soft-tuning of the face encoder's upper blocks, aligns face-recognition features with the style space of a frozen StyleTTS 2 model, kept frozen during training. We evaluate on held-out identities from LRS3, a large-scale audiovisual corpus of English TED-talk videos. The synthesized speech is highly natural (UTMOS 3.7-4.0, matching or exceeding the 3.61 of ground truth), face-to-voice retrieval is consistently above chance, and the generated voice is consistent with the target speaker. Without any retraining, an English-trained adapter also produces fluent Spanish speech, indicating that the face-to-style mapping is largely language-agnostic.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: Face-to-speech synthesis from a face image contributes to digital human avatar creation by generating a plausible voice for the avatar.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Proposes a zero-shot Face-to-Speech framework that predicts a plausible voice from a static facial image by adapting face features to a frozen StyleTTS 2 style space, evaluated on LRS3 identities.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 文本转语音通常需要参考音频，但有些场景只有人脸图像可用。本文提出Face-to-Speech框架，通过轻量Face Adapter和软微调人脸编码器，将面部识别特征对齐到冻结StyleTTS 2的风格空间，从而从静态人脸预测合理声音。在LRS3的未见过身份上测试，合成语音自然度较高（UTMOS 3.7-4.0），为数字人/虚拟角色自动配音提供了新思路。
